$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$evidence = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot
$source = Join-Path $evidence 'picori-src-d377558/tmc-d377558d973c648e8d0dc491bf99af9aaa0d8067'
$packages = Join-Path $evidence 'picori-xmake-state/.xmake/packages'
$compiler = 'C:/msys64/ucrt64/bin'
$env:Path = "$compiler;$env:Path"

$json = Get-ChildItem (Join-Path $packages 'n/nlohmann_json/v3.12.0') -Recurse -Filter json.hpp | Select-Object -First 1
$fmt = Get-ChildItem (Join-Path $packages 'f/fmt/12.2.1') -Recurse -Filter format.h | Select-Object -First 1
if (!$json -or !$fmt) { throw 'Pinned nlohmann_json or fmt headers are missing.' }

$sounds = [IO.File]::ReadAllBytes((Join-Path $source 'assets/sounds.json'))
$literal = [string]::Join(',', $sounds.ForEach({ '0x' + $_.ToString('X2') }))
[IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'sounds.json.h'), $literal)

$defines = @('-DPC_PORT', '-DNON_MATCHING', '-DUSA', '-DENGLISH', '-DREVISION=0')
$includes = @("-I$source/include", "-I$source/port", "-I$source", "-I$source/tools/src/assets_extractor",
    "-I$PSScriptRoot", ('-I' + $json.Directory.Parent.FullName), ('-I' + $fmt.Directory.Parent.FullName))
$index = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'port_asset_index.o'
& "$compiler/gcc.exe" -std=c11 -O2 @defines @includes -c "$source/port/port_asset_index.c" -o $index
if ($LASTEXITCODE) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }

$files = @(
    'tools/src/assets_extractor/assets_extractor_api.cpp'
    'tools/src/assets_extractor/assets_extractor_main.cpp'
    'tools/src/assets_extractor/embedded_sounds_json.cpp'
    'port/port_asset_pipeline.cpp'
    'port/port_asset_log.cpp'
    'port/port_asset_pak.cpp'
)
$inputFiles = $files.ForEach({ Join-Path $source $_ })
$executable = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'asset_extractor.exe'
& "$compiler/g++.exe" -std=c++20 -O2 -DFMT_HEADER_ONLY @defines @includes @inputFiles $index `
    -static -static-libgcc -static-libstdc++ -o $executable
if ($LASTEXITCODE) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $executable

from pathlib import Path
import urllib.request, hashlib, zipfile, subprocess, shutil, json
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
deps=root/'deps';deps.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
pins=[
 ('imgui','ocornut/imgui','4806a1924ff6181180bf5e4b8b79ab4394118875'),
 ('stormlib','ladislav-zezula/StormLib','28c9b4be3f23c6b3a5ff55cacac7dbe5b9cdc4fc'),
 ('libgfxd','glankk/libgfxd','008f73dca8ebc9151b205959b17773a19c5bd0da'),
 ('threadpool','bshoshany/thread-pool','097aa718f25d44315cadb80b407144ad455ee4f9'),
 ('prism','KiritoDv/prism-processor','1de054450e7b3c5f777d2e3dfcb228ad120c329d'),
 ('monocypher','LoupVaillant/Monocypher','0d85f98c9d9b0227e42cf795cb527dff372b40a4'),
]
manifest={}
for name,repo,commit in pins:
 p=deps/(name+'.zip')
 if not p.exists():
  with urllib.request.urlopen(f'https://codeload.github.com/{repo}/zip/{commit}',timeout=60) as r:data=r.read(100*1024*1024+1)
  assert len(data)<=100*1024*1024
  p.write_bytes(data)
 manifest[name]={'repo':repo,'commit':commit,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
 target=deps/name
 with zipfile.ZipFile(p) as z:
  assert z.testzip() is None
  for f in z.infolist():
   parts=Path(f.filename).parts[1:]
   if f.is_dir() or not parts:continue
   assert all(x not in ('.','..') and ':' not in x for x in parts)
   out=target.joinpath(*parts);out.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
   if not out.exists():out.write_bytes(z.read(f))
 if name in ('imgui','stormlib'):
  patch=root/'upstream/libultraship/cmake/dependencies/patches'/('imgui-fixes-and-config.patch' if name=='imgui' else 'stormlib-optimizations.patch')
  if subprocess.run(['git','apply','--reverse','--check',str(patch)],cwd=target,capture_output=True).returncode!=0:
   subprocess.run(['git','apply','--check',str(patch)],cwd=target,check=True)
   subprocess.run(['git','apply',str(patch)],cwd=target,check=True)
  manifest[name]['patch_sha256']=hashlib.sha256(patch.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
 print(name,manifest[name],flush=True)
p=deps/'stb_image.h'
if not p.exists():
 with urllib.request.urlopen('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nothings/stb/0bc88af4de5fb022db643c2d8e549a0927749354/stb_image.h',timeout=30) as r:p.write_bytes(r.read(1024*1024))
manifest['stb']={'commit':'0bc88af4de5fb022db643c2d8e549a0927749354','sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
(root/'deps-lock.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2)+'\n')
# Do not invoke original bootstrap or compile the game. Use upstream targets only.
up=root/'upstream'
cm=up/'libultraship/cmake/dependencies/common.cmake'
s=cm.read_text()
line=next(x for x in s.splitlines() if x.startswith('file(DOWNLOAD') and 'stb_image.h' in x)
s=s.replace(line,'file(COPY "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../deps/stb_image.h" DESTINATION "${STB_DIR}")')
cm.write_text(s)
(up/'CMakeLists.txt').rename(up/'CMakeLists.upstream.txt') if not (up/'CMakeLists.upstream.txt').exists() else None
(up/'CMakeLists.txt').write_text('''cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.26)
project(AllFix2ShipZapd VERSION 5.0.1 LANGUAGES C CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY "MultiThreaded$<$<CONFIG:Debug>:Debug>")
set(GAME_STR MM)
set(GFX_DEBUG_DISASSEMBLER ON)
set(GBI_UCODE F3DEX_GBI_2)
set(INCLUDE_MPQ_SUPPORT ON)
set(USE_AUTO_VCPKG OFF)
set(ENABLE_SCRIPTING OFF)
add_compile_definitions(CONTROLLERBUTTONS_T=uint32_t)
add_compile_options($<$<CXX_COMPILER_ID:MSVC>:/utf-8>)
include(CMake/Utils.cmake)
add_subdirectory(libultraship)
target_compile_definitions(libultraship PUBLIC INCLUDE_MPQ_SUPPORT)
add_subdirectory(ZAPDTR/ZAPD ZAPD)
add_subdirectory(OTRExporter)
''')
print('Sources ready')
